claims.text: The evaluation metrics used include the word error rate (WER) and BLEU score.
The WER is defined as the number of insertions, substitutions, and deletions divided by the total length of the reference, reflecting the effort needed to correct the generated output.
The model achieved a BLEU score of 19.67 on the test set, indicating the quality of the generated text compared to reference texts.
